configuration.synthetic_clock: 15 seconds after each last bar; fixed throughout measurement

unusable_subsection: Cross-thread cProfile produced impossible negative self-times in feature_store. No fine-grained profiler timing is used for optimization estimates; raw data retained. Follow-up profiler will run inline on one thread, timed workload stays unchanged.
reliable_basis: perf_counter elapsed pipeline wall; process_time whole-process CPU; thread_time stage spans on their own worker; wrapper call counts; input/output hashes and zero fallback
feature_store_side_effect_review: Real feature engineer logs latency; feature store performs QA and creates timestamped snapshot. Proposed optimization preserves all of these and caches only ML output.
next_step: Root authorized bounded ML feature cache with exact dependencies/deep copy/bounds; no deployment or profitability claim.

test_evidence.prior_attempt_note: Development harness problems and concurrent-source refusal; no aggregate sum across repeated tests.

limitations: Synthetic 500-row continuous-minute data does not reproduce exchange sessions, sparse IEX delivery or live symbol distributions.
Measures feature acquisition/computation only; no decision, ranking, sizing, model inference, entry/exit, broker, database or persistence workload.
No engine/brain instance or model deserialization; VersionedFeatureStore computes real features without a DB session.
Timed passes include small stage counter/clock overhead. Profiled passes have substantial cProfile overhead and are not latency estimates.
The extra profile pass serializes measured functions because Python 3.12 cProfile reserves an interpreter-wide monitoring ID; timed passes retain original concurrency.
Summed overlapping call wall times are not elapsed pipeline time; cumulative function CPU rows overlap and must not be added.
Fixed fresh synthetic clock excludes aging while CPU is busy; this cannot qualify live freshness or safe entry admission.
Concurrent machine load and local Python/library versions affect results; no live equivalence or profit claim.
